reasoning_content:
The arelorian.de serves static files from /opt/areloria/client/dist, not the API server on port 3000. There's no proxy to the game server. I need to add an API location block OR create a new config that proxies game.arelorian.de to port 3000.

Let me check game.arelorian.de config.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check game.arelorian.de config
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cat /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/game.arelorian.de")
print("Config:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
